thread:
Marie: Heads-up — SigmaHealth wants to cut 30 seats mid-term and is asking for a credit note + updated invoice. Procurement also needs a PO referencing the amendment. Can we coordinate ownership and timeline?
Elliot: Adding context — current commit is 600 seats, annual term ends 2026-09-30. They want reduction effective 2026-05-01. Rough numbers: 30 seats @ $3k/seat/year => pro-rated credit ~ $5k? need exact calc.
Vanessa: Confirmed on call with their procurement rep this morning. They submitted an email asking for a prorated refund and an invoice showing the new recurring amount + credit note for the unused portion. They insisted on a PO for the delta before we issue credits.
Renee: For billing: we need (1) customer signed amendment or clear emailed approval, (2) effective date, (3) original invoice ids to apply credit. Do we have the invoice numbers?
Elliot: Original invoice is INV-2026-0422-01 (annual charge posted 2026-04-22). They paid via CC. If we issue a credit, it should go as a credit memo against that invoice.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-0422-01: amount $1,800,000, paid 2026-04-22, method: cc-last4:4242.
Marie: Oliver — legal: do we need an amendment sign-off or will an email thread suffice for accounting? Procurement is pushing for a signed doc.
Oliver: For a term/seat reduction we require at minimum an executed amendment (signature) unless the contract explicitly allows unilateral mid-term reductions (it doesn't). We can fast-track a short amendment (1 paragraph) and route for e-sign. ETA: I can draft and send for signature today if finance/billing confirm numbers.
Vanessa: If we can get a 24–48h turnaround on the amendment, procurement will sign. I'll own chasing them. Marie, can you confirm the exact credit amount so legal can plug it in?
Elliot: Quick calc: 30 seats * $3,000/year = $90,000 annual. Pro-rate for 4 months remaining on term (May–Sep) => credit = $90,000 * (5/12) = $37,500. But their billing is annual upfront; confirm proration policy.
Renee: Redwood proration policy: refunds for seat reductions are prorated on remaining days and issued as a credit memo. We need the exact day-of-change. If effective 2026-05-01, 153 days remaining of 365. I'll compute exact and attach credit memo draft.
Marie: Ok — use 2026-05-01 as effective date. Renee, please calculate exact credit and draft credit memo. Oliver, once legal has the amount I'll send the amendment for e-sign. Vanessa, you'll confirm procurement will sign within 48h.
Renee: Credit calc (rough) inlined:
```
Seat price annual = $3,000
Seats removed = 30
Annual removal = 90,000
Days remaining = 153 / 365 => proration = 0.419
Estimated credit = 90,000 * 0.419 = $37,710
```
I'll generate a proper credit memo and post the CM id here once created.
Oliver: Drafting amendment now. I'll include: effective date, seats removed, credit memo ID placeholder, and signatory block for both parties. Will use DocuSign.
Elliot: One procurement ask — they want the credit reflected on a revised invoice and a separate credit note PDF for their AP system. Can billing provide both?
Renee: Yes — we can issue a revised invoice showing new recurring amount and a separate credit memo PDF. We will flag the revised invoice with `AMENDMENT-2040124600` in description for traceability.
billing-bot: Created draft credit memo CM-2026-0503-001 (status: pending).
Marie: Next steps: Renee finalize CM and revised invoice, Oliver finish amendment, Vanessa chase procurement, Elliot confirm PO or confirm CC refund path, Marie to coordinate signatures. Tight timeline — target to have docs out by EOD tomorrow.
Vanessa: Procurement confirmed 48h turnaround if amendment is in DocuSign and numbers match. I'll ping them after doc sent.
Oliver: Amendment drafted and uploaded to DocuSign. Link: https://docusign.example.com/ABC123 (internal)
Renee: Uploaded CM PDF and revised invoice (draft) to billing queue. CM-2026-0503-001, RI-2026-0503-002.
Elliot: I'll confirm PO vs refund after they respond. If they provide PO we won't process CC refund — we'll apply credit memo to next invoice per policy.
Marie: Great. If anyone hits blockers post the blocker here and tag me. :thumbsup:
Vanessa: Thanks team — I’ll update the customer and loop back once signed.
Elliot: 👍
Renee: CM finalized and queued for approval — will post when applied.
billing-bot: CM-2026-0503-001: status updated -> approved, applied to account.
Marie: Closing loop — thanks everyone. Follow-ups in thread as needed.
